title: Player Standard Auxiliary Component Candidate Catalog

installationClasses.description: Baseline ship systems installed through dedicated hull integration channels rather than generic Auxiliary Capacity.
installationClasses.duplicateRule: Additional or duplicate instances are not automatically core; they require an explicit dedicated mount or consume the appropriate Weapon Bay or Auxiliary Capacity.

installationClasses.description: Direct-fire batteries, launchers, and other primary attack packages installed in explicit weapon-bay capacity.
installationClasses.duplicateRule: Every additional battery or launcher consumes its declared Weapon Bay capacity unless a specific hull or component grants a dedicated mount.

installationClasses.description: Optional defensive, support, utility, logistics, and specialist modules that compete for generic Auxiliary Capacity.
installationClasses.duplicateRule: Every installed copy consumes its declared capacity, obeys stacking limits, and remains separately damageable when its profile says so.

foundation.hullTlRole: Hull TL governs cruiser-scale integration and may expand Auxiliary Capacity; TL3 is an expansion milestone, not necessarily the first existence of AUX capacity.
foundation.availabilityFormula: max(candidateFirstStandardItemTl, minimumPrimaryResearchTl, every support floor, minimumHullTl, compatibility and capacity legality, balanceEntryGate)
foundation.availabilityInterpretation: The formula gives the earliest candidate review point, not automatic production availability.
foundation.tl1FixtureEvidencePolicy: A TL1 mechanics fixture proves rule behavior only. It does not prove that the component is a valid standard TL1 player choice.
foundation.balanceEntryPolicy: When a component is overpowered at its proposed entry TL, first move its candidate starting TL upward. Change its established mechanical identity only if it remains unhealthy at the later floor.
foundation.alienAndPrecursorPolicy: Alien, Precursor, and rare rule-breaking components remain outside this standard player catalog.
